SCNet / SCNet-large by starrytong. Optional model weights are not bundled.
ONNX conversion and compact weights: audiojs.
Pinned model: https://huggingface.co/audiojs/scnet-large/tree/95f22d9e68f6cab78aef358f1a0de248d4edf805
Pinned smaller model: https://huggingface.co/audiojs/scnet/tree/e71bcdb42bce1d62b7fae25ba90fcbcf90f73f46
Author's explicit permission for pretrained weights and ONNX redistribution:
https://github.com/starrytong/SCNet/issues/35#issuecomment-4999873539
